agents.name: Mission Controller
agents.description: Coordinates VAPT missions, enforces budgets, dispatches agents, tracks progress, and halts unsafe actions.

agents.name: Attack Surface Ranker
agents.description: Ranks target assets by exposure, business criticality, auth boundary, and technology risk.

agents.name: Correlator Agent
agents.description: Correlates assets, technologies, CVEs, endpoints, and credentials across the attack lifecycle.

agents.name: Coverage Auditor
agents.description: Ensures exhaustive test coverage across target endpoints, parameters, and protocol ports.

agents.name: Asset Discovery Agent
agents.description: Performs passive & active subdomain enumeration, certificate transparency searches, and IP resolution.

agents.name: DNS Specialist Agent
agents.description: Discovers A/AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS records, wildcard resolution, and dangling takeover records.

agents.name: Network Discovery Agent
agents.description: Performs port scanning, service enumeration, and banner grabbing.

agents.name: Web Surface Agent
agents.description: Crawls endpoints, links, forms, parameters, redirects, and HTTP methods.

agents.name: API Discovery Agent
agents.description: Detects REST, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL endpoints, and parameter schemas.

agents.name: Cloud Recon Agent
agents.description: Identifies public S3/Blob storage, serverless functions, and cloud metadata exposure.

agents.name: Technology Fingerprint Agent
agents.description: Identifies CMS, frameworks, web servers, CDNs, and component versions.

agents.name: Authentication Specialist
agents.description: Validates session management, password policies, MFA bypass, and brute force defenses.

agents.name: IDOR Specialist
agents.description: Tests for Insecure Direct Object References and multi-tenant authorization bypass.

agents.name: XSS Specialist
agents.description: Detects Stored, Reflected, and DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting vulnerabilities.

agents.name: SQL Injection Specialist
agents.description: Validates Error, Boolean, and Time-based SQL Injection with safe non-destructive proofs.

agents.name: NoSQL Injection Specialist
agents.description: Tests MongoDB/CouchDB operator injections ($gt, $ne, $regex).

agents.name: SSRF Specialist
agents.description: Tests Server-Side Request Forgery against cloud metadata and internal subnets.

agents.name: SSTI Specialist
agents.description: Identifies Server-Side Template Injection across Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker, Velocity.

agents.name: XXE Specialist
agents.description: Validates XML External Entity vulnerabilities and schema parsing flaws.

agents.name: CSRF Specialist
agents.description: Checks SameSite cookie flags, anti-CSRF token validation, and state-changing endpoints.

agents.name: CORS Specialist
agents.description: Audits Access-Control-Allow-Origin, null origin acceptance, and wildcard credentials.

agents.name: OAuth Specialist
agents.description: Validates redirect_uri validation, state parameter CSRF, and token leakage in OAuth/OIDC.

agents.name: GraphQL Specialist
agents.description: Tests introspection disclosure, circular query DoS, and nested batching flaws.

agents.name: File Upload Specialist
agents.description: Tests extension validation, MIME bypass, SVG XSS, and path traversal in upload handlers.

agents.name: Path Traversal Specialist
agents.description: Tests directory traversal and Local File Inclusion (LFI) sequences.

agents.name: Command Injection Specialist
agents.description: Detects OS command injection via pipes, backticks, and shell separators.

agents.name: Deserialization Specialist
agents.description: Checks Java, Python pickle, PHP, and YAML insecure object deserialization.

agents.name: Open Redirect Specialist
agents.description: Audits unvalidated parameter-based redirects and protocol smuggling.

agents.name: Business Logic Specialist
agents.description: Tests negative currency amounts, coupon reuse, workflow step skipping, and limit bypass.

agents.name: Race Condition Specialist
agents.description: Performs concurrent HTTP request synchronization (Limit-overrun / TOCTOU).

agents.name: TLS/SSL Specialist
agents.description: Audits cipher suites, weak protocol versions (SSLv3, TLS 1.0), and certificate expiry.

agents.name: Service Misconfiguration Specialist
agents.description: Checks default banners, debug endpoints, server status pages, and exposed stack traces.

agents.name: Exposed Service Specialist
agents.description: Identifies exposed databases (Redis, Mongo, Elasticsearch, Memcached) without auth.

agents.name: Container Security Specialist
agents.description: Checks exposed Docker daemon sockets, unconfined capabilities, and container breakout vectors.

agents.name: Kubernetes Specialist
agents.description: Audits exposed kubelet ports, API server anonymous access, and etcd exposure.

agents.name: Cloud Misconfiguration Specialist
agents.description: Detects public cloud buckets, overly permissive IAM roles, and exposed metadata endpoints.

agents.name: Repo Architecture Mapper
agents.description: Maps codebase dependencies, frameworks, entrypoints, and architectural layers.

agents.name: Entrypoint Analyzer
agents.description: Discovers web routers, controllers, and RPC entrypoints in source code.

agents.name: Source-Sink Analyzer
agents.description: Traces untrusted user input sources to sensitive sinks (eval, query, exec).

agents.name: Data Flow Analyzer
agents.description: Validates sanitization, encoding, and validation along data flows.

agents.name: Secret Detection Agent
agents.description: Scans for hardcoded API keys, passwords, JWT secrets, and private keys.

agents.name: Dependency Vulnerability Agent
agents.description: Audits vulnerable third-party dependencies, CVEs, and outdated libraries.

agents.name: SAST-to-DAST Exploitability Agent
agents.description: Validates whether a static analysis warning is actually reachable and exploitable via DAST.

agents.name: Exploit Planner
agents.description: Devises minimal, safe proof-of-concept verification strategies.

agents.name: PoC Builder
agents.description: Constructs non-destructive, single-step reproduction payloads.

agents.name: Browser Verifier
agents.description: Executes headless browser sessions to verify DOM-based and client-side impacts.

agents.name: State Verifier
agents.description: Confirms that application state altered by proof is safely restored.

agents.name: Capability Extractor
agents.description: Extracts the concrete attacker capability unlocked by a verified vulnerability.

agents.name: Attack Chain Builder
agents.description: Links compatible attacker capabilities into multi-step attack graphs.

agents.name: Devil's Advocate Agent
agents.description: Challenges every candidate finding to attempt to disprove or downgrade false positives.

agents.name: Severity Validator
agents.description: Calibrates CVSS scores based on practical exploitability and local context.

agents.name: Duplicate Validator
agents.description: Eliminates redundant alerts from overlapping scanners.

agents.name: Evidence Validator
agents.description: Verifies cryptographic hashes and completeness of HTTP request/response proofs.

agents.name: Cyber Risk Analyst
agents.description: Calculates multi-variable cyber risk integrating asset value, exposure, and impact.

agents.name: ATT&CK Technique Mapper
agents.description: Maps verified attack chains to MITRE ATT&CK enterprise techniques.

agents.name: Remediation Prioritizer
agents.description: Ranks vulnerabilities by net risk reduction rather than raw CVSS severity.

agents.name: Investment Optimizer
agents.description: Calculates remediation ROI (Risk Reduction vs Implementation Cost) for budget planning.

agents.name: Technical Report Writer
agents.description: Generates developer-ready, reproducible vulnerability documentation with PoCs.

agents.name: Executive Summary Agent
agents.description: Produces high-level risk narratives, posture indices, and trend summaries for C-suite.

agents.name: Compliance Mapper
agents.description: Maps findings and remediation outcomes to ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and HIPAA controls.
